  • RHS: (13 mod 5)=3, (7 mod 5)=2 → 3×2=6 → 6 mod 5 = 1.
  • Verified.
  • Marks: Steps 4 + final 2

questions.question: i) Encrypt the message IN THE BOOK using the function f(p) = ( 2p +5) mod 26 ii) Generate 10 Pseudorandom Numbers using xn+1 = (4xn + 3) mod 4. with x0=3
questions.solution_html:
• (i) Affine cipher (8 marks)
  • Use f(p)=2p+5 mod 26.
  • Convert text → apply function → convert back.
  • Marks: conversion 3 + encryption steps 3 + final text 2
  • (ii) Pseudorandom numbers (7 marks)
  • xn+1=(4xn+3) mod 4, start x0=3.
  • Generate 10 values.
  • Marks: 5 steps + 2 final sequence
